cards.ex: Many felt the politician betrayed an ideal when they compromised on environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik siyosatchi atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha murosaga kelganida idealga xiyonat qildi deb hisobladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingiz ilgari himoya qilgan muhim tamoyil yoki g'oyadan voz kechish.

cards.ex: Choosing between my job and my family became a question of loyalty.
cards.exUz: Ishim va oilam o'rtasida tanlov qilish sodiqlik masalasiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Sodiqlikni sinovdan o'tkazadigan vaziyat yoki qaror.

cards.ex: The general shifted allegiance to the rebel forces.
cards.exUz: General isyonkor kuchlarga sodiqligini o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir tomon yoki guruhdan boshqasiga sodiqlikni o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: I don't want to be beholden to anyone for my success.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatim uchun hech kimdan minnatdor bo'lishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir yordam olgani uchun minnatdor bo'lish va uning xohishlariga bo'ysunish.

cards.ex: There's an implicit loyalty within the police force.
cards.exUz: Politsiya kuchlarida so'zsiz sadoqat mavjud.
cards.uzDef: So'z bilan aytilmagan, lekin mavjud deb hisoblangan sadoqat.

cards.ex: The company flouted the law by dumping waste illegally.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya chiqindilarni noqonuniy tashlash orqali qonunga bepisand bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni bilib turib buzish, hurmat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: He suffered from divided loyalties between his family and his country.
cards.exUz: U oilasi va mamlakati o'rtasida bo'lingan sadoqatdan aziyat chekdi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yoki undan ortiq tomonlarga nisbatan sadoqat hissi, qaysi birini tanlash qiyin.

cards.ex: His questionable allegiance made him a suspect in the investigation.
cards.exUz: Uning shubhali sadoqati uni tergovda gumonlanuvchiga aylantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Sadoqatning rostligi yoki sabablari shubhali bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: In our team, loyalty is paramount; we always support each other.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoada sodiqlik eng muhim; biz har doim bir-birimizni qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Sodiqlik eng muhim narsa, birinchi o'rinda turadi.

cards.ex: Knights swore an oath of fealty to their king.
cards.exUz: Ritsarlar o'z qiroliga sadoqat qasamyodini qabul qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishiga yoki tashkilotga sadoqatli bo'lishga qasamyod qilish.

cards.ex: His actions were seen as a breach of faith with his supporters.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari tarafdorlariga nisbatan sodiqlik buzilishi sifatida baholandi.
cards.uzDef: Vada yoki kelishuvni buzish, ishonchni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The spy defected to the enemy, revealing crucial information.
cards.exUz: Josus dushmanga o'tib, muhim ma'lumotlarni oshkor qildi.
cards.uzDef: Dushmanga o'tish, unga yordam berish va o'z tomoningizga xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: He threw his colleague under the bus to save his own job.
cards.exUz: U o'z ishini saqlab qolish uchun hamkasbini sotdi/aybladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni o'zingizni himoya qilish uchun ayblash yoki qiyin ahvolga solish.

cards.ex: After the scandal, people began to question his loyalty to the company.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan so'ng, odamlar uning kompaniyaga sodiqligiga shubha qila boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir sodiqligiga shubha qilish, uni tekshirishga urinish.

cards.ex: I always have my best friend's back, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Men har doim eng yaxshi do'stimni himoya qilaman, nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir himoya qilish, qo'llab-quvvatlash, xavf ostida qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: The mayor was suspected of being in league with the mafia.
cards.exUz: Shahar hokimi mafiya bilan til biriktirganlikda gumon qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan yashirincha hamkorlik qilish, birgalikda yomon ishlar qilish.

cards.ex: I felt it was a real stab in the back when he took my promotion.
cards.exUz: U mening lavozimimni olganida, bu haqiqiy xiyonat bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish, orqadan pichoq urish, xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: Betrayal of a friend is one of the hardest things to forgive.
cards.exUz: Do'st xiyonatini kechirish eng qiyin narsalardan biridir.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlik munosabatlarida ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish, xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: The authorities turned a blind eye to the illegal activities.
cards.exUz: Rasmiylar noqonuniy faoliyatga ko'z yumdilar.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir noto'g'ri bo'lishiga qaramay, ko'rmaganga olish, e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: A true friend always puts you first when you need help.
cards.exUz: Haqiqiy do'st doim yordamga muhtoj bo'lganingizda sizni birinchi o'ringa qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning manfaatlarini o'zingiznikidan ustun qo'yish, g'amxo'rlik qilish.

cards.ex: In this sensitive matter, discretion is key to avoid causing further problems.
cards.exUz: Ushbu nozik masalada, qo'shimcha muammolarni oldini olish uchun ehtiyotkorlik muhim.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan vaziyatda ehtiyotkor va sir saqlash juda muhim.

cards.ex: I was furious when I found out he had gone behind my back to negotiate the deal.
cards.exUz: U kelishuvni muzokara qilish uchun mening orqamdan borganini bilganimda g'azablandim.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ruxsatisiz yoki bilmasdan unga qarshi harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The soldiers showed unswerving allegiance to their country.
cards.exUz: Askar o'z mamlakatiga qat'iy sadoqat ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishsiz, doimiy va qat'iy sodiqlik.

cards.ex: She decided to throw in her lot with the rebels, despite the risks.
cards.exUz: U xavfga qaramay, isyonchilar bilan taqdirini bog'lashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan birgalikda harakat qilish, taqdirini ularning taqdiri bilan bog'lash.

cards.ex: The company acted in bad faith by denying the employee's valid claim.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xodimning haqiqiy da'vosini rad etish orqali yomon niyatda harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Halol bo'lmaslik, yolg'on ishlatish, aldash niyatida harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her leaving was like a stab in the heart; I never expected it.
cards.exUz: Uning ketishi qalbga xiyonatga o'xshardi; men hech qachon bunday bo'lishini kutmagan edim.
cards.uzDef: Juda og'ir xiyonat, qalbga chuqur yaralash.

cards.ex: He tried to keep his creditors at bay by making small payments.
cards.exUz: U kichik to'lovlar bilan kreditorlarni yaqinlashtirmaslikka harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir uzoqda saqlash, yaqinlashtirmaslik, oldini olish.

cards.ex: He had to prove his loyalty to the organization before being fully trusted.
cards.exUz: U to'liq ishonchga sazovor bo'lishidan oldin tashkilotga sodiqligini isbotlashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining sodiq ekanligini ko'rsatish, isbotlash, dalillash.

cards.ex: The company's questionable ethics led to several lawsuits.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning shubhali axloqi bir nechta sud da'volariga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy tamoyillarga zid bo'lgan, shubhali harakatlar.

cards.ex: It's important to be true to oneself, even when it's difficult.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lsa ham, o'ziga sodiq bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'zining tamoyillariga, qadriyatlariga va e'tiqodlariga sodiq qolish.
